note: Reviewed inputs of scripts/features/feature_schema.py. Controls and fields come from the frozen identity seeds in dbt/seeds/features; this file names only what no seed holds: the kind of a key when it is not a number, the field lists the models write in SQL, and the mask each family takes. Change it by review, then run python -m scripts.features.feature_schema generate.

categories.reason: Each published spelling maps to one category (edv_category); the score is text
Cost report rule code: type of control is a code, not a quantity
Cost report rule code: provider type is a code, not a quantity
Impact file rule code: the labor market area is a code
Impact file rule code: the urban or rural geography is a code
Meets-criteria flag Y or N, published as text
Rural-urban continuum code is a category

both_kinds.reason: Developer names (text) and the count of developers (number)
Y or not_reported (text) and the count of private equity owners (number)
Y or not_reported (text) and the count of REIT owners (number)
Change-of-ownership types (text) and the count of events (number)

masks.own_snapshot_state: state_source = 'pos_own': the state comes from the window's own POS snapshot, which ends in the 12 months before the window start
masks.own_snapshot_county: county_source = 'pos_own': the county comes from the own snapshot (its HUD fill uses the quarter in force at the snapshot's own period end)
masks.own_snapshot_classification: classification_source = 'pos_own': the provider subtype and control type come from the own snapshot
masks.county_family: county_source = 'pos_own' and no planning region: a Connecticut window with any HUD planning region is masked even with a complete own snapshot
masks.ruca_zip: the spine ZIP equals the first five characters of the own snapshot's ZIP
